tool_analysis:
Step Analysis:
- The recorded browser session navigated to the Magento Admin Transactions grid, authenticated (login was performed earlier and will NOT be repeated by this tool), mapped the filter controls, closed an 'Incoming Message' popup, populated filters (Order ID, Transaction ID, Payment Method, Transaction Type, Is Closed, Created At from/to), changed rows-per-page, clicked Search and observed the grid result ('No records found'). The session captured robust XPath/CSS selectors anchored to the grid header text and recorded numeric interactive indexes.

Task Definition:
- Provide a reusable automation tool that: navigates to the Magento Admin Transactions page, optionally removes any blocking notification popup, applies a set of provided filter criteria (order id, transaction id, parent txn id, payment method, transaction type, is_closed, created date range, page size), clicks Search and returns the grid rows or the 'No records found.' message. The tool assumes an authenticated admin session is available (do not perform login).

Action Plan:
1. Navigate to the transactions URL under {base_url}.
2. Use an agentic step to close any notification popup that may block the filter row (dynamic presence).
3. Wait briefly for the filters to be interactable.
4. Fill filter inputs (Order ID, Transaction ID, Parent Transaction ID) using XPath selectors which anchor to header text.
5. Set dropdowns for Payment Method, Transaction Type and Is Closed using visible text selection.
6. Set Created At From/To inputs using provided YYYY-MM-DD strings.
7. Optionally change the per-page limit via select[name='limit'].
8. Click the Search button to apply filters.
9. Wait for any processing overlay to appear/disappear (fixed wait used for determinism) and then extract current grid rows or the 'No records found.' message.

Variable Identification (inputs required for reuse):
- base_url (required): base host for navigation.
- filter_order_id (optional): Order ID value to enter.
- filter_txn_id (optional): Transaction ID value to enter.
- filter_parent_txn_id (optional): Parent transaction ID.
- filter_payment_method (optional): Visible text label of payment method to choose.
- filter_txn_type (optional): Visible label of transaction type to choose.
- filter_is_closed (optional): 'Yes'/'No'/'All' to choose closed state.
- filter_created_from, filter_created_to (optional): date strings YYYY-MM-DD for range.
- limit (optional): rows per page value (20/30/50/100/200).

Step Optimization:
- Navigation: replaced multi-click navigation with a single deterministic navigation to '{base_url}/index.php/admin/sales_transactions/'.
- Popup handling: used an agentic step to close the notification popup because its presence is dynamic; this avoids brittle selectors or failing clicks when not present.
- Selectors: prefer visible-header-anchored XPath selectors to positional CSS nth-child selectors so the tool tolerates minor column reordering/customizations. XPaths target the header text (e.g. 'Order ID', 'Transaction ID', 'Payment Method', 'Transaction Type', 'Is Closed', 'Created At') then select descendant inputs/selects. These were extracted from the recorded session and are more reliable than pure class-based selectors.
- Deterministic waits: added short waits after navigation and after clicking Search to allow AJAX/processing overlays to appear/disappear; for robust automation frameworks these waits should be replaced with explicit 'wait until element invisible' checks, but the recorded steps used fixed waits during the demo.

Notes and constraints:
- The tool intentionally does NOT perform authentication; the recorded session included a login but the tool assumes the caller provides an authenticated session.
- The tool always attempts the same sequence of interactions (no branching). The agentic popup-close step is used only when needed and bounded in steps to avoid runaway behavior.
- All filter inputs are included as parameters (optional) — caller may pass empty strings to leave a field unchanged.

This tool is single-purpose: apply the provided filters to the Magento Admin Transactions grid and return the current grid rows or 'No records found.' evidence. Version: 1.0
name: search_sales_transactions
description: Automates applying filters on the Magento Admin Transactions grid and extracting the resulting rows. Navigates to the transactions page (assumes the current session is already authenticated), fills filter inputs (Order ID, Transaction ID, Parent Transaction ID), selects Payment Method, Transaction Type and Is Closed, sets Created At date range and page size, clicks Search and returns the grid rows (or 'No records found'). Uses header-text-anchored XPath selectors for robustness and an agent step to close any blocking notification popup if present.

steps.description: Navigate to the Magento Admin Transactions grid (assumes the agent is already authenticated).
Close any blocking notification popup so filter controls are reachable (agentic because the popup may or may not exist).
steps.task: If an 'Incoming Message' or other notification popup is present and obstructing the grid, click its close button/link. The popup commonly contains a 'close' link in the notification box.

steps.description: Wait briefly for the grid and filter row to become interactable after navigation/closing popup.
Enter Order ID into the Order ID filter input (left-to-right: second column). Leave blank to keep unchanged.
Enter Transaction ID (txn_id) into the Transaction ID filter input (third column). Leave blank to keep unchanged.
Enter Parent Transaction ID into the Parent Transaction ID filter input (fourth column). Leave blank to keep unchanged.
Select a Payment Method by visible text from the Payment Method dropdown (fifth column). Provide the visible option label; leave blank to keep 'All'.
Select Transaction Type by visible text (sixth column). Leave blank to keep 'All'.
Select Is Closed option ('Yes' or 'No') (seventh column). Leave blank to keep 'All'.
Enter Created At 'From' date (first input in the Created At column). Use format YYYY-MM-DD. Leave blank to keep unchanged.
Enter Created At 'To' date (second input in the Created At column). Use format YYYY-MM-DD. Leave blank to keep unchanged.
Set number of rows per page using the pager/limiter select (name='limit'). Leave blank to keep the current value.
Click the Search button to apply the grid filters.
Wait for the grid to refresh (processing overlay may appear while the server applies filters).
Return structured list of transaction rows or 'No records found.' evidence.
steps.goal: Extract all transaction rows currently displayed in the grid (map columns ID #, Order ID, Transaction ID, Parent Transaction ID, Payment Method Name, Transaction Type, Is Closed, Created At). If no rows are present, capture the 'No records found.' message.

input_schema.name: base_url
input_schema.description: Base URL of the Magento instance, e.g. 'http://dockerized-magento.local' (no trailing slash). Tool will navigate to '{base_url}/index.php/admin/sales_transactions/'.

input_schema.name: filter_order_id
input_schema.description: Order incremental ID to filter by. Corresponds to form field filter[order_id] in Magento admin grid.

input_schema.name: filter_txn_id
input_schema.description: Transaction ID (txn_id) to filter by. Corresponds to form field filter[txn_id].

input_schema.name: filter_parent_txn_id
input_schema.description: Parent transaction ID to filter by. Corresponds to form field filter[parent_txn_id].

input_schema.name: filter_payment_method
input_schema.description: Visible text of the Payment Method option to select (e.g. 'PayPal Express Checkout', 'Cash On Delivery'). Leave blank to keep 'All'. Use the visible option label, not internal value.

input_schema.name: filter_txn_type
input_schema.description: Visible text of the Transaction Type option to select (e.g. 'Order', 'Authorization', 'Capture', 'Void', 'Refund'). Leave blank to keep 'All'.

input_schema.name: filter_is_closed
input_schema.description: Filter for 'Is Closed' status. Use 'Yes', 'No' or 'All' (blank) to not restrict by closed state.

input_schema.name: filter_created_from
input_schema.description: Start date for Created At range (format YYYY-MM-DD). Leave blank to not set a start date.

input_schema.name: filter_created_to
input_schema.description: End date for Created At range (format YYYY-MM-DD). Leave blank to not set an end date.

input_schema.name: limit
input_schema.description: Rows per page (pager 'View N per page'). Use one of the shown options: '20','30','50','100','200'. Leave blank to keep the page default.
